analysis_type: Retrospective fixed-grid sensitivity audit of high-precision positive-period certificates and conservative native Fourier prediction envelopes over explicit parameter ellipsoids; no refitting, radius optimization or probability-region claim

critical_radius_rule.unit_support: For period p, use the frozen covariance diagonal to compute sqrt(C_pp); the positive-center critical value is center_p/sqrt(C_pp)
critical_radius_rule.fold_radius: rho_fold=min(b4/sqrt(C_b4b4),b7/sqrt(C_b7b7)); record both values and the limiting parameter
critical_radius_rule.strict_rule: Positive-period certification requires radius < rho_fold. The exact critical radius and larger radii do not produce a strictly positive lower bound and must not receive finite prediction envelopes
critical_radius_rule.geometric_scope: The critical radius is a geometric property of the selected ellipsoid, not a confidence level, optimal radius, physical period estimate or universal maximum
critical_radius_rule.negative_control: Reuse the frozen baseline implementation and require every fold's half-critical radius to be accepted and exact critical radius to be rejected
critical_radius_rule.zero_guard: Period minima in the implementation's scale-dependent numerical zero zone are rejected rather than labeled strictly positive

grid_rule.selection: Radii 1 and 2 are below the stage-47 baseline, 4 reproduces it, 8 and 16 widen it, and 32 is a coarse stress above the two smallest known analytic critical radii. No radius may be added, removed or replaced after inspecting case outcomes
grid_rule.case_evaluation: For every fold and radius, evaluate both period supports and record certified or unavailable status, both period minima and maxima, the analytic critical radius and the limiting parameter
grid_rule.envelope_evaluation: Only certified cases generate original Fourier prediction envelopes at all unique held-out months and residual upper bounds for all observations, using the actual sine and cosine signs without fixed-period or Taylor substitution
grid_rule.width_audit: Report maximum and median envelope widths and residual upper bounds per case. Unavailable cases retain null bounds and explicit unavailable counts rather than fabricated values
grid_rule.center_consistency: Require every available center prediction to remain inside its envelope and actual residual not to exceed its upper bound; this is arithmetic consistency, not probability coverage or external validation
grid_rule.grid_maximum: Report the largest certified radius within the fixed grid separately from the analytic critical radius; never call the grid maximum the exact safe maximum

baseline_rule.preservation: Recompute every radius-4 fold with the frozen stage-47 implementation and require fold identity, critical radii, period certificates, prediction envelopes, point results, coverage counts and fold aggregate widths to match the frozen baseline exactly
baseline_rule.baseline_totals: Require fold_count=5, available_point_count=168, covered_point_count=168, violation_point_count=0, unavailable_point_count=0 and center_prediction_envelope_mismatch_count=0; require max_envelope_width=17.64192935677042, median_envelope_width=13.164436414771593, max_residual_upper_bound=14.576765863967406 and median_residual_upper_bound=8.516811559710845
baseline_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite the stage-47 protocol, bounds, receipt, report, figure, Word document or manifest

numerical_rule.engine: Reuse the frozen 80-digit mpmath support, positive-period and original Fourier envelope implementation from stage 47
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Retain the 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter outward conversion
numerical_rule.certificate_class: High-precision numerical interval certificate, not exact rational algebra
numerical_rule.failure_preservation: Non-finite values, failed positive-definite checks, non-positive periods, exact critical radii and unavailable cases are retained explicitly

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生ENSO原生椭球半径敏感性_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, changed covariance matrices, changed folds, period bounds or post-hoc radius selection
No acceptance of the exact critical radius as strictly period-positive
No finite prediction or residual bound for unavailable or exact-critical cases
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage, optimal-radius, physical-period or physical-endogeneity claim
No use of center-prediction containment or actual-residual coverage as independent scientific validation
No calling the largest certified grid radius the exact or universal safe maximum
No calling independent coefficient relaxations a joint nonlinear optimum
No fixed-period or Taylor substitution for the native Fourier model
No rewriting of stage-47 historical files
No hiding of unavailable cases, limiting periods, wide envelopes or numerical failures
